agent_note: First-person retrospective narrator, heavily aphoristic quote set (10 of 27 gnomic) -- exactly the quotability bias METHODOLOGY warns about. Event-narration is 14 quotes, 13 past / 1 present. The lone present (q02653, 'but I see now') is narrating-instance present from a retrospective vantage, not simultaneous narration, so it does not make the book dual. Recurring pattern here: a present-tense generalization paired with a specific past-tense application clause (q02649, q02654, q02674) -- filed event/past because the quote is anchored in the story world; if a reviewer files those three gnomic instead, the split becomes 10 past / 1 present and the label is unchanged.
